document_info.title: Pearl Building Rating System
document_info.note: This appears to be Version 1.0, not Version 10

IDP-R1.title: Integrated Development Strategy
IDP-R1.intent: Ensure new development adopts the Integrated Development Process (IDP) to gain full benefit from integrated development approach
IDP-R1.point_structure: Binary - Required credit, no points awarded
criteria: Demonstrate team organization and IDP process chart
Develop implementation strategy for design-to-construction transitions
Show vision, objectives and targets for project

IDP-R2.title: Tenant Fit-Out Design & Construction Guide
IDP-R2.intent: Ensure design and construction of interior fit-out contributes to overall project sustainability objectives
IDP-R2.point_structure: Binary - Required credit (core & shell only), no points awarded
criteria: Develop Tenant Fit-Out Design & Construction Guide
Must accompany lease documents
Include IDP requirements, sustainability vision, and technical guidance

IDP-R3.title: Basic Commissioning
IDP-R3.intent: Ensure building performs as designed to protect occupant health and provide comfort
IDP-R3.point_structure: Binary - Required credit, no points awarded
criteria: Engage independent commissioning agent
Include comprehensive commissioning in specifications
Complete commissioning at building completion
Verify commissioning report prior to completion

criteria.design_rating: 4 pts: Conduct LCC analysis during concept design to evaluate and compare design options
criteria.construction_rating: 4 pts: Update LCC report with final construction costs

criteria.design_rating: 2 pts: Develop Guest Worker Accommodation Plan meeting Abu Dhabi Cabinet Decision No. 13/2009
criteria.construction_rating: 2 pts: Implement the Guest Worker Accommodation Plan with maintenance records and inspections

criteria.design_rating: 1 pt: CEMP prepared per EAD standards; 1 pt: Project Lead Contractor ISO 14001 or EHSMS certified
criteria.construction_rating: 1 pt: CEMP properly applied to site; 1 pt: Contractor maintains ISO 14001 or EHSMS certification

criteria.design_rating: 1 pt: Design team reviews building envelope design and specifications
criteria.construction_rating: 1 pt: Off-site testing of prototypes and on-site water/air-tightness testing performed

criteria.design_rating: 2 pts: Demonstrate re-commissioning plan for 1 and 2 years post-completion
criteria.construction_rating: 2 pts: Provide updated re-commissioning plan and O&M manual

criteria.design_rating: 1 pt: Develop Occupant Handbook; 1 pt: Design occupant feedback mechanism
criteria.construction_rating: 1 pt: Update Occupant Handbook; 1 pt: Build occupant feedback components

NS-R1.title: Natural Systems Assessment
NS-R1.intent: Ensure environmental baseline conditions are assessed before design process begins
NS-R1.point_structure: Binary - Required credit, no points awarded
criteria: Assessment at project site, area of probable impact, sub-regional, and regional scales
Identify opportunities and constraints
Prepare measurable KPIs to guide design

NS-R2.title: Natural Systems Protection
NS-R2.intent: Protect significant and valuable Natural Systems assets identified in NS-R1
NS-R2.point_structure: Binary - Required credit, no points awarded
criteria: Strategy 1 - Protection: Retain 100% of significant assets, 80% of valuable assets
Strategy 2 - Onsite Mitigation: Retain 70% of significant assets, 50% of valuable assets with mitigation at 2:1 ratio
Strategy 3 - Offsite Compensation: Off-site habitat creation at 2:1 ratio outside development areas

NS-R3.title: Natural Systems Design & Management Strategy
NS-R3.intent: Minimize resource demand and ensure long-term survival of landscaped/habitat areas
NS-R3.point_structure: Binary - Required credit, no points awarded
criteria: Develop Natural Systems Design and Management Strategy
Promote soil protection and enhancement
Include management of protected, enhanced, and restored areas

criteria.design_rating: 2 pts: Demonstrate at least 75% of site area has been previously developed
criteria.construction_rating: 2 pts: Confirm at least 75% previously developed area remains at final site

criteria.design_rating: 2 pts: Demonstrate site contamination via Phase I & II ASTM analysis; provide remediation strategy
criteria.construction_rating: 2 pts: Demonstrate site was contaminated and adequate remediation was completed

criteria.1_point: 50% of plants are native/adaptive drought/saline tolerant species with minimum 5 different types
criteria.2_points: 70% of plants are native/adaptive with minimum 10 different types

criteria.4_points: Create/restore Priority Habitat on-site (2x minimum landscape area) or off-site (4x minimum landscape area)
criteria.2_points: Create ecological corridors (minimum 40m width) linking to similar habitat types through neighbor collaboration

LBo-R1.title: Plan 2030
LBo-R1.intent: Ensure development supports the vision for Abu Dhabi Emirate
criteria: Development within Urban Growth Boundary
FAR, building height/mass consistent with Plan 2030, Development Code, Area Plan

LBo-R2.title: Urban Systems Assessment
LBo-R2.intent: Understand project site within urban context before design process begins
criteria: Assessment at local, sub-regional, and regional scales
Identify opportunities and constraints
Analysis of community facilities, public transit, land uses, solar orientation

LBo-R3.title: Outdoor Thermal Comfort Strategy
LBo-R3.intent: Increase outdoor thermal comfort and reduce thermal discomfort in public spaces
criteria: Minimum shading: Parking 40%, Public spaces 60%, Primary walkways 75%, Secondary walkways 75%, Cycle tracks 50%, Playgrounds 90%
High-albedo surfaces minimum SRI 29
Calculated at equinox and summer solstice at 1:00pm

criteria.1_point: Increased shading beyond minimums: Parking 50%, Public spaces 65%, Walkways 80%, Cycle tracks 55%
criteria.2_points: Further increased shading: Parking 55%, Public spaces 70%, Walkways 85%, Cycle tracks 65%

LBo-2.title: Pearl Rated Communities
LBo-2.criteria: 1 pt: Building located within Pearl Rated community

LBo-3.title: Accessible Community Facilities
LBo-3.criteria: 1 pt: Building within 350m walking distance of any 5 of these facilities: Mosque, Women's/Youth center, School, Library, Post office, Medical services, Grocery, Public open space, Retail (bank/restaurant/shopping)

LBo-4.title: Active Urban Environments
LBo-4.criteria: 1 pt: Provide outdoor spaces for recreation (landscaped areas, playgrounds, sports fields) with programming for communal, women/children only, and men only uses

LBo-5.title: Private Outdoor Space
LBo-5.criteria: 1 pt: 90% of residential units have private outdoor space ≥10% of unit floor area, minimum 2m x 3m, 95% shaded for 3+ hours (9am-5pm on July 21)

criteria.2_points: Within 350m of bus/tram stop with 15-minute max midday frequency
criteria.3_points: 2 points PLUS within 350m of metro or regional rail station

criteria.1_point: Adequate cycle parking (1 per 500m2 long-term commuter, 1 per 500m2 short-term visitor) with secure, shaded, Sheffield-type stands
criteria.2_points: 1 point PLUS shower/changing facilities (1 shower per 5,000m2 per gender) OR on-site cycle lanes with direct access to storage

LBo-8.title: Preferred Car Parking Spaces
LBo-8.criteria: 1 pt: 6% of parking spaces reserved for electric/gas/hybrid vehicles or car-sharing, with 50% supplied with charging points

LBo-9.title: Travel Plan
LBo-9.criteria: 1 pt: Develop and implement Travel Plan with car reduction targets (5-10% reduction expected in first 3 years), monitoring mechanisms, and remedial measures

criteria.interior: Interior lighting angle of maximum candela must not exit windows OR automatic shutoff outside occupancy hours
criteria.exterior: Non-safety/security lighting off 23:00-07:00hrs; Safety lighting at reduced levels per IESNA RP-33-99; Security lighting motion-activated
criteria.boundary: Meet IECC 2009 LZ requirements: LZ1 <1 Lux at boundary; LZ2 1.1 max at boundary; LZ3 2.2 max at boundary
